decisions.statement: The binary and the arguments it is handed are named by one list.
The binary is handed the environment the service has.
The binary writes to the streams the service was given.
A term or an interrupt reaching the service reaches the binary.
The service waits for the binary rather than leaving on the signal itself.
The service leaves on the code the binary left on.
A binary a signal ended leaves the service on the code that signal makes.
A call naming no binary is refused.
Nothing here starts the binary again.
Nothing here says where the binary is.
Nothing here says which folder the binary runs in.
Importing this module's file runs nothing.

definition: a foreign binary run as the whole of a service
